newsitem.title: POLAND: UNDERWRITERS TAKE 85 PCT AMERBANK ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: UNDERWRITERS TAKE 85 PCT AMERBANK ISSUE.

text.p: Investors subscribed for 228,135 shares of the 1.5-million-share issue of Polish bank Amerbank and underwriters took the remaining 1,271,865 shares, the bank said in a statement on Wednesday.

The underwriters are Polish Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK), Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH), oil and gas explorer Polskie Gornictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo and MC Concordia Sp zoo, a part of MC European Capital Holdings.
The issue price of the offering from September 23 to October 11 was 21 zlotys per share.
